name: jev-advise
description: Shows Jev's probabilities next to the choices Claude offers, without letting Claude or Jev see each other's recommendation

auto_select.title: Auto-select Jev's pick
auto_select.description: Answer AskUserQuestion with Jev's pick when Jev picks every question in it. Plain-text questions are never answered for you.

pick_threshold.title: Pick threshold
pick_threshold.description: Lowest Jev confidence (0 to 1) that counts as a pick, both for the jev pick tag and for auto-select.
